subject: Re: MUSIQ kickoff — validation status + latency trade-off
body:
Hi both,

Status: scoring API prototype landed 05-14, a day early. Validation looks good — the koniq_ckpt reproduces SRCC 0.916 on our KonIQ holdout, and spaq_ckpt is within 0.004 of the published correlation. Checkpoint loading from the release's .npz format was uneventful.

Trade-off we need a decision on: the default 3-scale model (native + 224 + 384) runs ~140 ms per image on an A100, dominated by the native-resolution scale on large photos. The MUSIQ-single variant (native resolution only, the full_size_single_scale checkpoint) runs ~55 ms with SRCC dropping about 0.01 on KonIQ. For the data-filtering pipelines, which score millions of images, I'd offer both: default endpoint = single-scale, opt-in flag for full 3-scale.

Leaderboard: Katya reports the submission API and KonIQ board working end to end; SPAQ and AVA boards next sprint.

Wei
